message:
fix(container): preserve publisher provenance across RIDs

Rebind SDK container labels at image creation when consumers provide the
complete publisher provenance inputs. Preserve ordinary local SDK behavior
when metadata is absent or partial.

Exercise actual MSBuild behavior and target removal using escaped fixture
XML without XML parsing. Retain scoped no-shell subprocess justifications.

Reapply through the normal checked PR path after the bounded revert
restored the preincident tree.
